name: description
meaning: the DirectSound device description DS_EnumCallback 0x406cfb strcpy's here (unbounded); SoundDevice_GetDeviceName 0x406812 copies it out for the launcher

name: guid
meaning: the device GUID DS_EnumCallback copies here (left zero for the primary device, whose GUID pointer is NULL); SoundDevice_Init 0x406859 passes its address to DirectSoundCreate
